intro: Chip Kid: Mech online! Snack time, and YOU'RE the snack, grandpa!
Chip Kid: Harborplace is my playground. No old people allowed!
taunt: Chip Kid: Sneeze, grandpa! Seasoning cloud incoming!
Chip Kid: My mech is bigger than your whole rowhouse!
Chip Kid: Can barrage! Duck, duck, too slow!
Chip Kid: Mom says I can stay out till I win.
Chip Kid: Crunch time! Get it? CRUNCH time!
hurt: Chip Kid: Hey! You dented my snack bag!
Chip Kid: Ow! That's not fair, you're old!
Chip Kid: Mech, stop wobbling! Stop it!
defeat: Chip Kid: My mech! It's all crumbs now!
Chip Kid: I'm telling my mom! MOOOM!
Chip Kid: Fine. You win. But I'm keeping the snacks.

intro: Duchess: Bow, peasant! The harbor bends to my royal paddle!
Duchess: A rowboat? Against MY dragon? How quaint.
taunt: Duchess: My dragon has more teeth than your whole crew.
Duchess: Splash! Do learn to swim, darling.
Duchess: Rule one of the harbor: the Duchess has right of way.
Duchess: Paddle faster, toad. Royalty doesn't wait.
Duchess: Another pier? Lovely. Smash into it for me.
hurt: Duchess: My figurehead! Do you know what that cost?
Duchess: How DARE you ram a royal vessel!
defeat: Duchess: Fine. The harbor is yours. Mop it yourself.
Duchess: My dragon's taking on water. And so am I.

intro: Brewmaster: The whole city drinks from my taps. You're no exception.
Brewmaster: Every gang answers to me. Tonight you answer too.
taunt: Brewmaster: One eye open, and it's watching you fail.
Brewmaster: My truck's full and my patience is empty.
Brewmaster: You're flat, toad. All foam, no fizz.
Brewmaster: I've been brewing trouble since before you hopped.
Brewmaster: My sign lights this harbor. You light nothing.
hurt: Brewmaster: That's coming out of your tab, toad!
Brewmaster: You cracked my sign. You'll pay for every letter!
defeat: Brewmaster: The taps run dry... the sign goes dark...
Brewmaster: Last call... for me. Didn't see it coming.
Brewmaster: The harbor's yours, toad. Keep it clean.

intro: Cobblestone: Yarr, a living toad aboard me ghost ship? Bold!
Cobblestone: Me lantern's lit. Your luck's not.
taunt: Cobblestone: Two hundred years at sea, and ye still bore me.
Cobblestone: Walk the plank, matey! It's a short one!
Cobblestone: Me crew's dead and still faster than ye.
Cobblestone: Swing that cane all ye like. I'm mostly fog.
Cobblestone: The deck creaks for ye, toad. So does yer back.
hurt: Cobblestone: Blast! Ye clipped me lantern!
Cobblestone: Arr, that one rattled me bones!
Cobblestone: How does a stick hit a ghost?!
defeat: Cobblestone: Me lantern dims... the fog calls me home...
Cobblestone: Ye've earned the ship, landlubber.
Cobblestone: Tell the harbor... Cobblestone fought well...

intro: Scrubber: Hon, I scrubbed these steps at dawn. Don't you DARE.
Scrubber: Muddy feet on my marble? Oh, it's ON, toad.
taunt: Scrubber: Slippery, ain't it? That's elbow grease, hon.
Scrubber: My bucket's full and my brush is angry.
Scrubber: Wipe your feet! WIPE THEM!
Scrubber: These steps shine brighter than your future.
Scrubber: Suds in your eyes, sweetie? Oops.
hurt: Scrubber: My bucket! You kicked my bucket!
Scrubber: Ugh, a scuff! A SCUFF, hon!
Scrubber: Now I gotta scrub that twice!
defeat: Scrubber: Alright, hon. You can sit. Just wipe your feet.
Scrubber: My brush is bent. My pride too.
Scrubber: Clean fight, toad. Cleaner than my steps.

intro: Pigeon: Ah, a visitor. Straighten your hat, we dress for dinner here.
Pigeon: Welcome to the penthouse, toad. Mind the velvet.
taunt: Pigeon: *adjusts monocle* Is that... a toad? On MY roof?
Pigeon: My smoking jacket costs more than your block.
Pigeon: Coo. Such dreadful manners, climbing uninvited.
Pigeon: I'd offer you a seat, but you'd soil it.
Pigeon: The view's divine. Pity you'll be leaving so soon.
hurt: Pigeon: My monocle! It's popped right out!
Pigeon: The velvet! You've wrinkled the velvet!
defeat: Pigeon: Very well. The penthouse is yours. Do water the plants.
Pigeon: Defeated by a toad. Mother will never let me forget.
Pigeon: *drops monocle* I need a little lie-down.

start: Lights out and away they go!
Harold's off the line like a rocket!
lap: Lap one done, and the toad is flying!
Through the hairpin, clean as a whistle!
lead_change: Harold takes the lead! What a move!
He's been passed! The toad drops to second!
Back in front! The crowd goes wild!
crash: Into the barrier! That'll leave a mark!
Spin! He's facing the wrong way!
final_lap: FINAL LAP! Everything on the line!
One more lap! Hold it together, Harold!
win: A toad takes the Harbor Grand Prix!
Victory lap for the old toad!
lose: Second place. Close, but no trophy.
Out of the race! Tow truck to turn four!
So close! Mavis says next year, hon.

otters: Swim back to your lily pad.
phantoms: Back to the mist with ye!
